about_the_game:
This demo covers the opening of Star Rift Saga up to the first boss.

You'll start on the planet in an abbreviated tutorial, then start your journey to save Atlas by closing your first rift, meeting the locals, learning about the skill chip system, and fighting the first boss. There are also optional secrets to find.

Progress is accelerated in this demo so you can experience more of the skill chip system. While you explore, you'll encounter skill chips at rarities that normally would be encountered later in the game, allowing you to play the demo again to encounter different chips and try out new builds.
